text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: Fails core inclusion criteria. The primary focus is on modeling urban development impacts (housing shortage, traffic congestion) using an ABM to allocate population growth to predefined land parcels/districts. It does not predict or simulate Land Use/Land Cover (LULC) change. The land use classification (residential, mixed, other) is a static input used to constrain population allocation, not a dynamically predicted output. The study implements scenarios for urban growth policy but does not produce mapped LULC projections based on LULC change drivers or transitions.)
